listen_ip.description: IP address to bind L2TP control port (UDP 1701). Use 0.0.0.0 to listen on all interfaces.

max_sessions.description: Maximum number of concurrent L2TP sessions allowed.

lac_mode.description: Run in LAC (Access Concentrator) mode instead of LNS (Network Server) mode. Rarely needed for typical VPN setups.

control_secret.description: Shared secret for authenticating L2TP control channel messages. Required for peer trust.

data_secret.description: Shared secret for L2TP data channel encryption (optional). Leave empty to disable data channel auth.

tunnel_timeout.description: Idle timeout (in seconds) for L2TP tunnels before they are torn down.

session_timeout.description: Idle timeout (in seconds) for individual PPP sessions.

ipcomp.description: Enable IP payload compression for L2TP data traffic (may reduce CPU load but increase latency).

multilink.description: Enable PPP multilink to bundle multiple PPP sessions (useful for load balancing).

ip_pool.description: IPv4 address ranges (CIDR or start-end) to allocate to clients.

dns_servers.description: DNS servers to push to connected clients (optional).

wins_servers.description: WINS servers to push to clients (optional, mostly for legacy Windows compatibility).

default_route.description: Push a default route (0.0.0.0/0) to clients, forcing all traffic through the tunnel.

users.description: Static user accounts with per-user configuration.

ip.description: Static IP address assigned to this user (optional; empty = use IP pool).

mschapv2.description: Enable MS-CHAPv2 authentication for this user instead of PAP.

session_timeout.description: Per-user session timeout (seconds); 0 = use global default.

ip_pool.description: Custom IP pool name for this user (if multiple pools defined elsewhere; not standard in l2tpns).

rate_limit.description: Upload/download rate limit in kbps (e.g., '1024:512' = 1024 up, 512 down).

hosts.description: Predefined trusted peer hosts (e.g., for L2TP interconnection or static LNS/LAC pairing).

hostname.description: Hostname or IP of the trusted peer.

ip.description: Local IP to use for the peer tunnel (optional; auto-detected otherwise).

secret.description: Secret for peer authentication; if empty, uses global control_secret.

mschapv2.description: Force MS-CHAPv2 for host authentication (not typically used for L2TP hosts).
